tools.subtitle: The same decimal engines as the upcoming trade form - no floating-point approximation, per-instrument conventions.
tools.sizingDesc: Estimate position size from account balance, risk and stop distance. Broker volume rules and FX conversion are configurable; execution costs and slippage are not included.
tools.pnlDesc: Pips, points, R multiple, planned and realized R:R - computed live, exactly as in the logging form.
tools.instrumentsDesc: Loaded from the database via /api/instruments - the same source will feed the trade pickers. The XAUUSD pip convention (0.10 by default) is documented and configurable there.
tools.riskPercentInputAria: Risk as a percentage of the balance
tools.riskRewardDesc: See the win rate you need, estimate your average result per trade and keep an eye on your daily risk using your own trading data.
tools.rrTableDesc: Compare win rates and reward-to-risk ratios. Each cell shows the estimated result per trade in R. Select a row to explore a reward-to-risk ratio.
tools.rrYourStatsLine: Your stats: {winRate}% win rate, {avgRR}:1 average planned R:R, over {n} closed trades.
tools.rrNoTrades: You do not have any closed trades yet. Log a few trades to see your win rate and average reward-to-risk ratio here.
tools.rrRequiredDesc: For a given reward-to-risk ratio, this is the win rate needed to break even: 1 / (1 + R:R). Expectancy estimates your average result per trade.
tools.rrYouAbove: Your win rate ({winRate}%) is above the {required}% break-even level for this ratio. Based on these inputs, the setup has positive expectancy.
tools.rrYouBelow: Your win rate ({winRate}%) is below the {required}% break-even level for this ratio. Based on these inputs, the setup has negative expectancy.
tools.rrScenariosDesc: Save a win rate, reward-to-risk ratio and risk amount so you can compare different trading scenarios later.
tools.rrBudgetDesc: Choose how much risk you are prepared to take on in a trading day, as a percentage of your account balance.
tools.rrBudgetNote: This budget includes the risk in your open positions and your realized losses for today. A prop firm daily-loss limit may count realized losses differently, so do not treat these figures as interchangeable.
tools.rrBudgetOver: Daily risk budget used up. New trades add risk on top of a budget that is already consumed - consider stopping for today.
tools.rrLoadError: Could not load your risk data. The calculator still works with the values you enter.
tools.rrCompoundDesc: Explore how your balance could change over time if your average result and risk per trade stayed the same.
tools.rrCompoundWarning: This is only a projection, not a promise. It assumes the same average result and risk on every trade. Real results vary, and past performance does not predict future results.
tools.rrCompoundEmpty: Enter a starting balance, an expectancy, a risk per trade, trades per month and a number of months to see the projection.
tools.convertedEstimate: Result converted with the provided rate - treated as an estimate.
tools.roundingNote: Rounded down to the configured broker volume step. Estimated stop risk stays within the requested risk before trading costs and slippage; actual execution can differ. Exact decimal calculations are used.
tools.quoteDiffersNote: The quote currency ({quote}) differs from the account currency (USD): the result is shown as an estimate. In the journal, the broker's real P&L can always be entered manually and overrides the calculation.

IP addresses are NEVER stored in clear: they are hashed (HMAC-SHA256 with a secret pepper) for rate limiting and view counting.

p.deletionBody: A deletion request takes effect after a 7-day grace period, cancellable at any time. Execution cascade-deletes every table linked to your account, including screenshot files on disk.
p.recipientsBody: No data is sold, rented or shared with third parties. Trade sharing (public links, mentoring) is strictly voluntary, controlled by you, revocable at any time and filtered by a redaction policy.
